Class PropertyManager

java.lang.Object
PropertyManager
public class PropertyManager extends Object
Manages properties and reservations in the Property Management System. Provides methods to add, find, remove, and display properties, as well as create and display reservations.

    • isDateAvailable

      public boolean isDateAvailable(int propertyId, LocalDate checkIn, LocalDate checkOut)
      Checks whether a property is available for the requested dates. Prevents overlapping reservations for the same property. Allows a new guest to check in on another guest's checkout date.
      Parameters:
      propertyId - the ID of the property
      checkIn - the requested check-in date
      checkOut - the requested check-out date
      Returns:
      true if the dates are valid and do not overlap with another reservation, otherwise false

    • createReservation

      public boolean createReservation(int propertyId, String guestName, LocalDate checkIn, LocalDate checkOut)
      Creates a new guest reservation for a property. Checks that the property exists, is available, and that the guest name and reservation dates are valid. Also prevents overlapping reservations.
      Parameters:
      propertyId - the ID of the property being reserved
      guestName - the name of the guest
      checkIn - the reservation check-in date
      checkOut - the reservation check-out date
      Returns:
      true if the reservation was created, otherwise false

    • displayReservations

      public String displayReservations()
      Displays information about all guest reservations. Returns a message if no reservations have been created.
      Returns:
      a string containing all reservation details, or a message if the reservation list is empty
